0022600191.text: The New York Knicks (4-4) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-4) for the Knicks' ninth game of the season, with New York 1-2 on the road and Cleveland 4-1 at home. Josh Hart is out for the Knicks with an ankle injury, while the Cavaliers are without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and list Jarrett Allen (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow) as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently winning 130-93 in Cleveland on May 25.
